assets.name: Office Notepads
assets.description: Free 4K model of assorted office notepads: blank sheets, lined legal pads with red glue, index cards, and sticky notes. Realistic paper grain and crisp edges.
assets.suggestedUse: Loose notepads, blank sheets and sticky notes scattered on the desk or shelf edge; covers the approved "loose papers" lived-in category.
assets.suggestedPlacement: Desk corner or shelf edge, near the streaming workstation.
assets.reviewStatus: awaiting independent review; not integrated into Unity

assets.name: Stationery Supplies
assets.description: Free 4k model of assorted stationery: scuffed pens, colored and graphite pencils with worn paint, pink eraser and engraved metal cup, realistic and finely detailed props.
assets.suggestedUse: Pens, pencils and an eraser in a worn metal cup; small desk clutter for the student routine.
assets.suggestedPlacement: Workstation desk, beside the monitor or keyboard.
assets.reviewStatus: awaiting independent review; not integrated into Unity

assets.name: Clipboard
assets.description: Free 8K model of a worn masonite clipboard with a shiny chrome clip, engraved logo, rounded corners, scuffs and edge wear, showing a lived-in look.
assets.suggestedUse: Worn clipboard holding a sheet; document clutter that reads as study/work material.
assets.suggestedPlacement: Desk or shelf, flat on a surface so it does not float.
assets.reviewStatus: awaiting independent review; not integrated into Unity

assets.name: Plastic Thermos
assets.description: Free 4k model. Olive-green plastic thermos with beige cup-lid, molded handle, textured grip panels, ribbed base and light scuffs for a worn, realistic finish.
assets.suggestedUse: Olive plastic thermos with cup lid; the standard water container for an Indonesian kos room.
assets.reviewStatus: awaiting independent review; not integrated into Unity

assets.name: Plastic Crate 02
assets.description: Free 4K model of a rugged plastic crate with vented sides, stackable ribs, and cutout handles. Adjustable color with subtle scuffs and molded seams.
assets.suggestedUse: Stackable plastic crate for personal storage (books, cables, supplies).
assets.suggestedPlacement: Under the bed or at the foot of the wardrobe, on the floor.
assets.reviewStatus: awaiting independent review; not integrated into Unity

assets.name: Industrial Plastic Container
assets.description: Free 4K model of an industrial blue plastic container with hinged grid lids, scuffed wear, a dirtied base, molded ribs, and small sticker details.
assets.suggestedUse: Lidded plastic storage box with ribbed sides; storage for clothing or electronics.
assets.suggestedPlacement: Top of the wardrobe or under the desk.
assets.reviewStatus: awaiting independent review; not integrated into Unity

assets.name: Gamepad
assets.description: Free 4K model: retro wired gray gamepad with D-pad, four colored face buttons, start/select switches, worn plastic and long cable.
assets.suggestedUse: Worn wired gamepad with its coiled cable; streamer/gamer clutter and a believable cable source.
assets.suggestedPlacement: Desk surface next to the keyboard.
assets.reviewStatus: awaiting independent review; not integrated into Unity

assets.name: Retro Multimeter
assets.description: Free 4K model of a vintage analog multimeter with carry handle, glass needle gauge, detailed rotary dial, worn decals, and coiled red/black probes.
assets.suggestedUse: Analog multimeter with coiled red/black probes; fits Raka tinkering with his stream rig.
assets.suggestedPlacement: Desk or shelf; keep the probes resting on the surface.
assets.reviewStatus: awaiting independent review; not integrated into Unity

assets.name: Cassette Player
assets.description: Free 4K model of a vintage cassette player, with brushed metal case, front speaker grille, tactile transport buttons, built-in mic and labeled tape.
assets.suggestedUse: Old radio/cassette unit; lived-in music device for a budget room.
assets.suggestedPlacement: Shelf or desk edge, against the wall.
assets.reviewStatus: awaiting independent review; not integrated into Unity

assets.name: Wall Clock
assets.description: Free 4K model of a modern wall clock with a worn metal bezel, clear glass, bold numerals, gray hour/minute hands, and a slim red second hand on a clean dial.
assets.suggestedUse: Wall clock with worn bezel; typical kos room fixture and a quiet horror-friendly prop.
assets.suggestedPlacement: Wall, above the desk or near the door.
assets.reviewStatus: awaiting independent review; not integrated into Unity

assets.name: Alarm Clock 01
assets.description: Free 8K rigged model of a retro aqua twin-bell bedside alarm clock with worn metal, Roman numerals, and animatable parts.
assets.suggestedUse: Twin-bell bedside alarm clock; supports the 03:45 story time without new gameplay.
assets.suggestedPlacement: Bedside stool or shelf. The model is rigged but no animation is used.
assets.reviewStatus: awaiting independent review; not integrated into Unity

assets.name: Wooden Broom
assets.description: Free 4K model of a weathered wooden broom with stiff straw bristles, rusted metal supports, cracked wood grain, and authentic wear.
assets.suggestedUse: Weathered straw broom (sapu ijuk); the believable cleaning tool in a modest Indonesian room.
assets.suggestedPlacement: Leaning in a corner by the door or window, with a simple fitted collider.
assets.reviewStatus: awaiting independent review; not integrated into Unity

assets.name: Vintage Flashlight
assets.description: Free 4K model of a vintage flashlight with a weathered red battery box, chunky black handle, polished metal reflector and authentic scratches, dents and bolts.
assets.suggestedUse: Worn flashlight for power cuts; atmospheric prop that fits the horror opening without adding mechanics.
assets.suggestedPlacement: Bedside shelf or under the bed edge.
assets.reviewStatus: awaiting independent review; not integrated into Unity

rejectedCandidates.reason: Glossy porcelain with pink tulips; too ornate and luxurious for a modest kos.
Victorian tea set; western and luxurious, and 40k triangles.
Modern glossy decorative vase; no routine purpose in the room.
Ornate brass goblets; western antique styling.
African zigzag print; visually inconsistent with the room.
Travel stickers read as random decor without a routine purpose.
Farmhouse milk jug; not a believable Indonesian room prop.
Specialty gooseneck design fights the modest kos styling.
Western mini oven; heavier (13.9k tris) and no approved placement.
Redundant with cassette_player at almost double the triangles.
Plastic push broom; the wooden straw broom is the credible local choice.
42k-tri industrial outdoor cables; too heavy and stylistically wrong for an interior.
Rustic western crock; no routine need identified yet.
Could pair with the broom, but not part of the approved clutter list.
Plausible but purely decorative; deferred to avoid random props.
Redundant with the existing desktop workstation; deferred.

gapsNotCoveredByDownloads.topic: Used socks, flip-flops and worn clothing
gapsNotCoveredByDownloads.details: Poly Haven has no believable CC0 clothing items. The project already authors KosDroppedSocks, KosSandals, KosFoldedTshirt and HangingJacket, so downloads were not forced.

gapsNotCoveredByDownloads.topic: Realistic USB charger, power strip and loose cables
gapsNotCoveredByDownloads.details: Only modular_electric_cables exists and it is industrial (42k tris). The room already contains fitted charger/lead geometry; the gamepad and multimeter cover cable clutter.
No CC0 realistic source found; the project-authored newspaper and paper props remain in use.

gapsNotCoveredByDownloads.topic: Indonesia-specific appliances (rice cooker, gas hob, bamboo mat)
gapsNotCoveredByDownloads.details: Not available under CC0. Research deliberately stopped at sources with verified licenses instead of guessing at Sketchfab/OpenGameArt licenses.
